changelog: - **Twelve more node icons.** The Icon field in the Inspector now offers, under Nature and basics, partly cloudy, snow, lightning risk, strong wind (a tree bent by the wind), typhoon and temperature beside the cloud, the rain cloud and the wind; and under Industry and life, a cargo ship, oil, coal, a house, food and drink beside the car, the nuclear plant and the warehouse. That makes twenty-nine, listed with like beside like, so the weather marks sit together and the buildings and goods together. Each behaves like the first seventeen: a drawing before the node's name that changes nothing a run computes, saved in the file and in share links under the same revision note, named in all 18 languages. A file that uses one of them opens in an older version with that mark left out and the node kept.
